extension.description: Stremio for Kodi program addon with embedded Nimbus Home and media information. Nimbus layouts and artwork by Ivar Brandt. Kodi remains the playback engine; the global Kodi skin is unchanged.
extension.news: 1.0.43: Add free BYOK Gemini AI subtitle translation with Auto video-first subtitle selection and Stremio-addon fallback, batched translation, exact timestamp preservation and caching. Add a full Stremio for Kodi Settings interface for account, playback, subtitles/AI, appearance, weather, ratings, cache, support and the Premium placeholder. Vortexo Premium hosted AI remains in construction.
